result.instructions: Tools for Joy Loyalty, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many loyalty points does customer 8720295559390 have, and what tier are they in?"; "List the customers who joined a VIP tier this month."; "Show the last 20 points transactions and the reason for each.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Joy Loyalty data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run joyloyalty_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run joyloyalty_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run joyloyalty_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. joyloyalty_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: joyloyalty_whoami
tools.title: Get shop info
tools.description: Return safe information about the connected Shopify shop (name, plan, currency, timezone). A good first call. GET /rest_api/v2/whoami.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_shop_settings
tools.title: Get shop settings
tools.description: Return the loyalty shop settings (program switches and widget options). GET /rest_api/v2/shop/settings.

tools.name: joyloyalty_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List loyalty customers with points, tier and order counts. Paginate with after/before. GET /rest_api/v2/customers.

after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item on the previous page.

before.description: Cursor: the id of the first item on the current page, to go back.

hasCount.description: Include total counts (may slow the response).

order.description: Sort order, for example createdAt_desc, createdAt_asc, updatedAt_desc.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one loyalty customer by Joy customer id: points, tier and activity. GET /rest_api/v2/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_customer_by_shopify_id
tools.title: Get customer by Shopify id
tools.description: Get one loyalty customer by their Shopify customer id. GET /rest_api/v2/customers/external/{shopifyCustomerId}.

shopifyCustomerId.description: Shopify customer id (numeric string), for example "8720295559390".

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_customer_points_earned
tools.title: Get customer earned points
tools.description: Return the points one customer has earned in total. GET /rest_api/v2/customers/{customerId}/points/earned.

tools.title: List points transactions
tools.description: List points transactions (earn, spend, manual adjustments) newest first by default. Paginate with after/before. GET /rest_api/v2/transactions.

after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item on the previous page.

before.description: Cursor: the id of the first item on the current page, to go back.

hasCount.description: Include total counts (may slow the response).

order.description: Sort order, for example createdAt_desc, createdAt_asc, updatedAt_desc.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_transaction
tools.title: Get points transaction
tools.description: Get one points transaction by id. GET /rest_api/v2/transactions/{transactionId}.

tools.name: joyloyalty_award_points
tools.title: Award points
tools.description: WRITE: add points to a customer's balance (manual award). Changes live loyalty data and is not safe to repeat. POST /rest_api/v2/transactions/points/award.

shopifyCustomerId.description: Shopify customer id (numeric string), for example "8720295559390".

adminNote.description: Internal note for the shop team.

shopifyCustomerId.description: Shopify customer id (numeric string), for example "8720295559390".
